history.change: Crypto trend as the code runs it (v2/v3 since 5 Nov): two slots per coin (BTC, ETH, SOL, XRP), long only. A daily close above the prior 55 daily highs, or above the prior 100 daily highs, buys at market on the next run (one open trade per slot). Catastrophe stop 5 x ATR(20) below the entry, fixed. Exit: a daily close under the ratcheting midpoint of that slot's own 55- or 100-day channel (high+low)/2, at market. One add per trade at +1R (cryptoAdd), with its own 5 ATR stop, leaving with the first trade. A coin stops opening trend trades once its forward trend total reaches -8R (cryptoTrendStopR). Trades opened before v3 keep their own rule (kATR trail, out under the 27/50-day low).
history.why: history catch-up: code changed without a history entry (the 5 Nov pairs-best entry still describes v1: 55-day breakout, 4 ATR trail, out under the 27-day low).
